sentences.en: Anyone who breaks this rule is liable to severe punishment.
sentences.zh: 任何违反此规则的人都可能受到严厉惩罚。

sentences.en: In a similar situation, the company was held liable.
sentences.zh: 在类似的情况下，该公司被认定为有责任的一方。

sentences.en: We are liable to judge others by the clothes they wear.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会根据别人的穿着来评判他们。

phrases.zh: 都负有责任的；都有可能

senses.zh: 可能的，很有可能的；有法律责任的，应负责任的；易于...的，有...倾向的
